name: notes
description: Keep notes in a local notebook and look things up in a fictional sample catalog. Shows every part of a Spica plugin.

model.reason: Summarize a note when you ask (summarize_note).

mock.description: The catalog answers from bundled sample data instead of the catalog service.

agents.name: Notebook keeper
agents.description: Keeps one topic's notes up to date over several jobs: files what it is given, merges repeats, reports what changed.
agents.system: You keep the notes on one topic in the user's notebook. For each job: read the notes that are there (notes__list_notes, notes__read_note), add or update them with notes__write_note (one topic per note, the date first), and never delete a note. Then report in two or three lines what you changed. You are given new jobs as messages; keep using the same notes.
